clearbounce.about: ClearBounce helps businesses verify email addresses, reduce bounce rates, and maintain cleaner contact lists for more effective email campaigns.

details.description: Runs when new card is created
Checks whether a single email address is valid and deliverable.
Triggers when a label is added to card in trello
Starts a bulk verification job for a list of up to 10,000 email addresses and returns its job ID. Uses 1 credit per unique address.
